summary: Runner bootstrap lockfile prevents parallel ephemeral runners after secret swap
description:
Issue summary:
During a scheduled KMS-backed secret rotation for the ephemeral runner bootstrap secret (runner-bootstrap-key), pods in the release queue entered Pending for extended periods. Pipelines stalled for several release jobs across multiple repos. Impact was limited to release pipelines that spawn parallel ephemeral runners (nightly-release and canary-rollouts).

Impact:
- ~45 release jobs blocked for 90+ minutes in us-east-1
- No commits were deployed during the window; customer-facing rollouts delayed
- Manual requeueing worked but caused repeated flakiness and extra toil for release engineering

Environment:
- Prod Kubernetes (EKS) cluster: prod-us-east (k8s v1.26)
- Runner type: ephemeral pod with init container that fetches and unwraps secrets from vault via the secrets-sync sidecar
- Secret provider: internal KMS -> Vault rewrap flow; rotation occurred 2026-03-10 03:15 UTC

Steps to reproduce:
1) Deploy a job that launches 4 parallel ephemeral runners using release runner template v2.1.
2) Trigger a KMS rewrap of runner-bootstrap-key and wait for secrets-sync to perform hot-swap (simulated in staging).
3) Observe runner init container logs and pod state.

Observed behavior / Logs:
- Pods stayed in Pending with "Init:CrashLoopBackOff" or "Init:ErrImagePull" depending on timing.
- Init container logs show: "acquire_lock: waiting for lock file /var/run/runner_bootstrap.lock" repeatedly, then a stack trace when the secret volume was remounted.
- The first pod that started during rotation created the lockfile but its init container crashed during secret unwrap; lockfile persisted in the shared emptyDir volume slice used by init containers on that node. Subsequent runners blocked on the same lockfile and timed out.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Schedule parallel ephemeral runners (n>2) using v2.1 template.
2) Initiate secret rotation on runner-bootstrap-key while runners are booting (or simulate remount in staging).
3) Watch init container logs for lockfile acquisition and failure.
4) Observe other runner pods blocked on lock acquisition.

investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: lockfile-based bootstrap coordination assumes init lifecycle will always clean up lock on failure; KMS rotation caused an unexpected remount path that left stale lockfile in place.
Checks performed:
- Confirmed secret rotation timeline via kms-ops and vault audit (rotation started 03:15 UTC).
- Examined node-level emptyDir mounts: lockfile present on node(s) where affected pods scheduled.
- Reviewed runner bootstrap code: uses file lock at /var/run/runner_bootstrap.lock in an emptyDir shared between init containers and sidecar helper. No TTL or stale-lock reaper.
- Verified that the first init process crashed after partial unwrap, leaving the lock in place.

Partial mitigation tests in staging:
- Added reaper logic to init image to force-delete stale lock after 30s if the owner PID is gone — prevented blocks in test cluster.
- Re-deploying affected pods on same node without reaping required manual node restart to clear emptyDir.
workaround:
- Requeue affected jobs one-by-one to land on fresh nodes (non-ideal).
- For immediate relief, cordon + drain the nodes with stale emptyDir to clear the file.
- Temporary policy: pause secret rotations for 1 hour around scheduled release windows until fix is rolled out.
proposed_fix:
1) Modify runner init bootstrap to use a lockfile with process PID check + stale TTL and attempt to re-acquire after a bounded backoff.
2) Update secrets-sync to create atomic rename-based swaps for the unwrap output to avoid mid-unpack crashes leaving partial artifacts.
3) Add observability: metric for lockfile wait time and alert when >30s and queue length grows.
4) Backport small reaper into v2.1 runner image and roll as hotfix across prod nodes.
resolution: In progress: patched init image with PID-aware lock reaper (30s) and staged rollout to prod-us-east. On 2026-03-12 05:40 UTC we rolled the image to 20% of nodes and observed no further lockfile stalls for new releases. Full rollout scheduled for 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC after smoke tests. Final resolution will include secrets-sync atomic write change in a follow-up PR.
